Forwarding Emma's note. Team — we need to lock a sequencing plan and debrief anchors. High-level goals: validate system design at scale, a short live problem (or pair-debug), and behavioral/culture fit. Proposed multi-slot layout attached.

Quick asks:
- Laura: can you take systems design lead (50m)?
- Marissa: can you own the coding slot (50m) — live pair or take-home follow-up?
- Tessa: can you host the 50m behavioral + org fit panel and run the 20–30m debrief?

Proposed agenda (see attached proposed_multi_slot_agenda.docx):
1) 09:30–10:20 — Systems: distributed storage tradeoffs (Laura lead)
2) 10:35–11:25 — Coding: incident debugging / short pairing (Marissa lead)
3) 11:40–12:30 — Behavioral + cross-functional (Tessa lead)
12:30–13:00 — Team debrief (Tessa)

Notes:
- Add 15-min buffers between slots to allow for break and tech snafus.
- We'll use the debrief rubric (link in doc) so feedback stays comparable.

Please reply with confirmed interviewer names and any objections by EOD today so I can lock the calendar and send candidate-facing invite.

Thanks — Jonas
